capabilities: Receive citekeys from the Zotero companion plugin
Run a configured Zotero Integration import format
Open the imported note in a new tab
Use configurable vault, folder and import format names
disambiguation: Not a citation or bibliography importer itself; it receives a citekey from Zotero and triggers a Zotero Integration import.
extras: Desktop only; the mobile app is not supported. Vault name, note folder and import format name must match the Zotero side exactly. Relies on Zotero Integration's runImport(), which is not a formally stable public API. Install, customization, troubleshooting and template guides live outside the README.
intentEvidence: Citekey Import Bridge calls Zotero Integration's runImport().
motivation: To turn the multi-step routine of importing a Zotero paper into Obsidian into a single right-click in Zotero.
problem: Getting from a paper in Zotero to its literature note in Obsidian means switching apps, opening the command palette and searching for the paper again.

relations.evidence: Citekey Import Bridge calls Zotero Integration's runImport().
two small plugins that work together: one for Zotero (Zotero Citekey Bridge) and one for Obsidian
You will also install two existing plugins: Better BibTeX for Zotero and Zotero Integration for Obsidian.

summary: Obsidian half of a Zotero bridge that receives a citekey, runs a Zotero Integration import, and opens the new note in a tab.
